title: My city
instructions: Lena yaşadığı şehri anlatıyor. Yerlere ve sevdiği şeylere dikkat et.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: I live in Vienna. It is the capital of Austria.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: It is a big and beautiful city.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: There are many museums, parks and cafés.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: I live in a flat near the river.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: I go to work by tram. It is fast and cheap.

script.speaker: lena
script.text: My favourite place is a small café in the old town. The cakes there are wonderful.
